SGLang — sgl-project/sglang

SGLang 摘要 — 2026-11-05

1. 今日亮点

过去 24 小时内没有新版本发布，但 issue 和 PR 活动依然活跃（61 个更新的 issue，500 个更新的 PR）。主要主题是 PD 分离正确性（一个 router 熔断器 bug、一个 Mooncake KV page stride 不匹配、一个 EAGLE 在 retraction 后解码损坏）以及通过 AITER 和 FlashInfer 0.7.3 进行的 AMD/Hopper kernel 调优。在基础设施方面，CI flakes 追踪器（#42752，目前 176 条评论）和 Q4 PD 分离路线图（#43699）仍是最活跃的协调线程。

2. 版本发布与破坏性变更

今日无新版本发布。两项具有迁移影响的前瞻性事项：

  • RFC：完整迁移到共享的 api.v1 后端 API（#45816）—— 将 sgl-processor、sgl-router 和 Rust 服务器迁移到统一的 api.v1.Generate schema。预计 router/processor 路径会出现接口变动。
  • FlashInfer 升级至 0.7.3 + flashinfer.moe_ep 迁移（#48468）—— 0.7.3 移除了 flashinfer.comm.MoeAlltoAll，因此升级和 NVLink 单边 all-to-all 迁移必须一起落地。如果你基于 FlashInfer 的 MoE 通信 API 构建，此项与你相关。

3. 新模型与硬件支持

  • Kimi-K3.1 PCP KV 分片，配合 HiCache + DFlash（#48469）—— 将持久化 DSA KV 页跨 rank 分片而非复制，为 TRTLLM DSA attention 组装。
  • Muse Spark Open cookbook：TPU v7（#48277）—— 单主机，4 芯片 / 8 TensorCore，--tp-size 8 通过 SGLang-TorchTPU 服务 NVFP4。
  • GLM-5.2 / GLM-5.3（GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM）：可中断 prefill CUDA graph 在交织上下文并行 prefill 下扩展，配合 fp8 KV + trtllm kernel（#46890）。
  • DeepSeek-V4 TRTLLM 稀疏 MLA：调用方拥有的 multi-CTA KV 计数器缓冲区，替代私有的 FlashInfer workaround（#48467）；这也解锁了 PD 分离 uniform-FP8 KV 布局请求（#37838，现已因不活跃关闭）。

4. 性能与优化

  • AMD AITER 在 gfx950 上确定性模式下的 prefill attention（#45601）—— 在 MI350X 上，Qwen3-8B @ 32k 输入使用 AITER batch prefill 将 Triton prefill attention 从 9.3s → 4.1s。
  • Kimi-K3 12-head MLA 在 gfx950 上（FP8 KV）（#45320）—— 将解码 + 8 token 验证迁移到 fp8-Q ASM，在 AgentX c1 流量上 P90 ITL 从 6.77ms → 6.18ms。
  • 无暂存拷贝的 paged experts（#48082）—— 通过消除可分页暂存复制，降低 checkpoint 加载期间的 host 内存占用。
  • --routed-experts-dtype int16（#47833）—— 将 --enable-return-routed-experts 的 routed-expert host 缓存减半。
  • LingBot-Video MoE 针对 B300 的 TMA 调优（#48470）—— 在 832×480×81 下 MoE 约占 kernel 总时间的 39%；启用现有的 up/down TMA 路径针对该区域。
  • 扩散：ERNIE-Image 的图像前缀序列并行（#48218）—— 修复此前在执行前导致 Ulysses2 请求失败的 4D 空间 latent 分片问题。

5. 稳定性与回归

按严重程度排序：

  1. Router 熔断器分发到已死的 decode，创建永久假死的 prefill（#31206）—— sgl-router v0.2.4 PD 模式；单个卡住的 prefill 可毒化集群状态。未引用修复 PR；自 7 月以来开放。
  2. Mooncake PD：KV page stride 不匹配静默损坏 decode KV 并溢出 layer 缓冲区（#48231，修复 #48230）—— 修复 PR 已开放。高影响：静默损坏，而非崩溃。
  3. Qwen EAGLE PD 解码在 retraction 后产生损坏输出（#48356）—— 昨日新增；尚无修复 PR。
  4. DSpark + TP：语法约束请求与任何其他请求批处理会导致所有 rank 死锁（#41449）—— 集合通信挂起，overlap 和非 overlap 模式均受影响。
  5. 混合 GDN 上的 HiCache：超过约 3 个长前缀后 host 层命中降至零（#45400）—— host mamba 池耗尽而 KV 仍在 host 上；长上下文混合模型的 prefix-cache 容量悬崖。
  6. Mooncake HiCache 对 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 备份失败（#48145）以及 mamba 惰性边界快照覆盖 keep slot（#48328，修复 PR 已开放）—— 混合/Mamba 路径中的 checkpoint 完整性。
  7. --tool-call-parser auto 在 Qwen2.5-0.5B、Qwen3 2507、Ling-mini-2.0 上找不到 parser（#48172）—— 工具调用以纯文本返回；影响较小模型上的 agent 集成。
  8. SM120 上的 DSV4 prefill 吞吐差距（#33422）—— 在 4× RTX PRO 6000 上约 2–7K tok/s，而 vLLM/marlin 约 12.5K；仍未解决，请求调优指导。

6. 对应用开发者的意义

  • 如果你运行 PD 分离，审计你的 router 版本和 Mooncake 注册路径：#31206 和 #48231 都是静默失败类别（一个是永久死 prefill 状态，一个是 KV 损坏）。如果你在 PD 下使用 EAGLE，在推出 retraction 密集的工作负载前关注 #48356。
  • 工具调用 agent：--tool-call-parser auto 在若干较小/基础模型上不可靠（#48172）。在生产中固定显式 parser，而非依赖自动检测。
  • 长上下文混合模型用户：HiCache host 层悬崖（#45400）意味着一旦被驱逐的工作集超过几个长前缀，前缀复用会急剧下降——相应调整 host mamba 池和长前缀并发。
  • AMD MI3xx/ROCm 部署正获得实质关注：确定性模式 prefill attention 和 MLA 验证 kernel 现已在审查中有具体的延迟收益，这对可复现性敏感的受监管工作负载很重要。
  • 可观测性：新的首答案 token 时间直方图（#48466）将推理 token 延迟与答案延迟分开——合并后值得为推理模型 SLO 采用。
llama.cpp — ggml-org/llama.cpp

llama.cpp 摘要 — 2026-11-05

1. 今日亮点

llama.cpp 发布了 v0.9.0，核心亮点包括 OCP FP8 E4M3 量化、新增 flash_attn_ext_rows 算子（实现高效的统一 KV 多序列推理）以及通用批量张量拷贝 API。与此同时，还合入了四个新架构（Clover、Limite、Metis-1.6、Mistral Large 4），并为 Drama-3 TTS 增加了音频支持。本次发布周期其余部分主要由后端调优（OpenCL/Adreno、Vulkan Intel）以及一批仍在分诊中的 Intel GPU 正确性/回归问题报告所占据。

2. 发布与破坏性变更

  • v0.9.0（b12110 版本号提升）：https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases —— 新增 OCP FP8 E4M3 量化、flash_attn_ext_rows、批量张量拷贝 API、4 个新架构、音频、Drama-3 TTS（b12116）。
  • 通过 flash_attn_ext_rows 实现多序列推理的统一 KV 缓存效率 —— 与任何以 --parallel N>1 运行 llama-server 的用户相关；这是一项能力变更，值得针对你的批处理路径进行验证。
  • -hf 量化标签匹配修复（b12100）：:F16 之类的标签不再匹配 BF16，:Q4_XS 不再匹配 IQ4_XS（现已改为按 token 边界锚定）。如果你的工具依赖宽松的标签匹配，请固定为精确的量化标签。https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31620
  • 服务器实时功能加固（b12119）：websocket 处理器现在通过 ex_wrapper 路由，并在异常时发出错误事件而不是崩溃 —— 对于此前在工具 schema 格式错误时会看到连接断开的客户端而言，这是行为变更（见 #31626）。https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31632

3. 新模型与硬件支持

  • 新架构：Clover、Limite、Metis-1.6、Mistral Large 4（v0.9.0）。
  • Drama-3 TTS 在 mtmd 中的音频支持（b12116）：https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31613
  • ricursiveAI Ripple‑65B（新稠密架构，转换器 + 计算图，无新增算子）—— 开放 PR：https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31692
  • CUDA TQ2_0 反量化 + MMVQ 面向三值模型（BitNet b1.58、BitCPM、Falcon3-1.58bit），使权重保留在 GPU 上而非回退到 CPU —— 开放 PR：https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30278
  • Hexagon SIN/COS/MEAN 算子 —— 开放 PR：https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31674
  • WebGPU：group norm 与 timestep embedding 内核（供下游 stable-diffusion.cpp 使用）—— PR #31490、#31695
  • SpacemiT 厂商指令前缀 以兼容上游 binutils —— PR #31677
  • 长期未决请求：XDNA 后端（#21725，37 条评论，39 👍）仍处于开放状态。

4. 性能与优化

  • OpenCL 配合 FA 的解码性能（b12118）：为 Q4_K gate-up + GLU 分配更多工作组，FA 处理 head size 为 256 的 GQA 2/6 —— 高通贡献的 Adreno 路径：https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31633
  • OpenCL Adreno X2：默认启用 f32 与 Q5_K 多列 GEMV 以加速 MTP 验证 —— PR #31694；非连续 sigmoid —— PR #31687；面向 Adreno X1 的 Q4_0 非 MoE GEMM bin 内核 —— PR #30947
  • GGUF writer：宿主缓冲区张量直接写出，跳过暂存拷贝（b12101）—— 对大型模型转换/写入吞吐量有显著意义：https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31144
  • HIP fast-math 在无回归的情况下启用 —— 开放 PR：https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31625
  • Vulkan Intel prefill FA 内核 —— 开放 PR：https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29357
  • MTP conv 快照批量合并为单个 set_rows 用于循环模型（qwen4exp、glm5-*）—— PR #31660，#30878/#31443/#31584 的后续工作

5. 稳定性与回归（按严重程度排序）

  1. CUDA 非法内存访问 —— Gemma 4 31B + draft-MTP 在 RTX 4060 Ti 上执行 KV 回滚/清除后触发（#31077）；此外 qwen4exp + draft-MTP 在服务器启动时以 GGML_ASSERT(buffer) 中止（#30860）。尚无关联修复 PR —— 对 MTP 用户而言为高严重度。
  2. Vulkan Intel 非确定性 —— KHR_coopmat 在 Arc Pro B70（BMG G31，Mesa 26.2.5）上对 BERT 类决策模型在 F16 和 Q8_0 下返回不同/错误的结果（#31560）；coopmat_stage 在 RTX 4090 上的共享内存预算低估（#31629）。正确性问题 —— 在修复前，将 Intel Vulkan coopmat 视为对决策/分类器工作负载不安全。
  3. Vulkan Intel 回归 —— Arc Pro B60：在 65840ed 与 29c720e 之间 tg128 从 20.1→13.0 t/s，pp512 从 1117→821 t/s（#31557）；Gemma 4 解码 −5% 二分定位至 0bb496db（#30018）；ANV FA 标量路径回退导致 O(N²) PP 性能下降（#27638）。
  4. SYCL 内存 —— --fit 低估使用量导致运行时溢出（#27595）；此前 ngram-mod 的极端 scratchpad 问题已作为陈旧问题关闭（#28860）。
  5. Vulkan 设备丢失 于 AMD RX 6900 XT（#27076，陈旧）。
  6. 服务器正确性 —— /v1/responses 将截断的工具调用报告为已完成且从不发出 function_call_arguments.done（#30773，违反契约）；/slots 恢复在混合/循环/SWA 模型上不产生 KV 复用（#28194）；路由器调度器在 --models-max 1 的并发冷启动时存在竞态（#28774）。
  7. 今日已修复：无效工具 schema 导致的实时崩溃（#31626，经 b12119 关闭）；GGUFReader 标量数组越界循环（PR #31627，已关闭）。
  8. Hexagon —— HTP v73 在 n≥5 时 MUL_MAT 出现 inf 以及 FA/DeltaNet 失败（#29473）；HTP v75 上视觉编码器因图像形状而损坏（#31104）。骁龙 7 系列目前实际上不可用。

6. 对应用开发者的意义

  • 如果你提供多序列工作负载，请升级到 v0.9.0 —— flash_attn_ext_rows 使统一 KV 在并行解码下更高效，直接改善 llama-server --parallel 的内存/吞吐量。在全面推广前，请针对你的评估集验证 FP8 E4M3 量化路径。
  • 收紧 -hf 量化标签：新的 token 边界匹配修复了一个真实陷阱 —— :F16 曾会静默拉取 BF16 权重。请审计任何已固定的模型引用。
  • MTP/投机解码仍是最大风险领域：两个未决的 CUDA 中止/IMA bug（#31077、#30860）影响 Gemma 4 和 qwen4exp 配合 --spec-type draft-mtp 使用。如果你在生产中依赖投机解码，请固定到已知良好的构建，并将 MTP 置于可回退到无投机解码的开关之后。
  • 对分类器/决策模型避免使用 Intel Vulkan coopmat，直到 #31560 解决 —— 对 agent 路由层而言，非确定性输出比慢速输出更糟。Arc B 系列也显示出可测量的回归（#31557）。
  • 实时/websocket 端点变得更安全：无效工具 schema 现在以错误事件形式呈现，而不是使服务器崩溃 —— 请更新客户端错误处理以消费这些事件。
  • OpenAI 兼容性缺口对 agent 框架很重要：/v1/responses 流式传输缺少终止性的 function_call_arguments.done 事件（#30773）。如果你的 SDK 等待该事件，将会挂起 —— 要么在客户端打补丁，要么跟踪该 issue。

规则：

  • 仅输出译文。无前言、无解释、无包围整个输出的 markdown 代码围栏。
  • 严格保留 Markdown 结构：标题、表格（包括列对齐行）、列表、引用块、粗体/斜体、水平分割线、emoji。
  • 保留 URL、链接目标、代码段、代码块、数字和日期原样。
  • 项目名称、仓库 slug、用户名、版本标签、文件路径和 API/配置标识符保留原形式 —— 不要翻译。
  • 诸如 #12345 的 issue/PR 引用及其链接文本保持原样。
  • 使用自然的技术中文，以中文开发者通讯的语域为准 —— 而非逐字直译。
Ollama — ollama/ollama

Ollama 摘要 — 2026-11-05

今日亮点

过去 24 小时内没有新版本发布，但 issue 跟踪器显示 v0.40.13/0.40.14 中出现了一组原生工具调用和 API 正确性回归问题（Windows RTX 5090 runner 断连、Qwen 工具调用失败、Responses API 截断）。在 PR 方面，MLX Qwen3/3.5 YaRN 缩放已合入，混合模型的 VRAM 预测被标记为过度计算，另有多个修复针对 OpenAI 兼容的工具结果处理和 SSE 刷新。

版本发布与破坏性变更

无。过去 24 小时内没有新版本标签。注意：多份报告将 v0.40.13 和 v0.40.14 视为当前版本；云端 /api/usage 似乎出现了回归（见稳定性部分）。

新模型与硬件支持

  • MLX Qwen3/Qwen3.5 YaRN 缩放 — PR #19231（已关闭）遵循显式 RoPE 缩放元数据，对文本和 mRoPE 应用 YaRN 频率/幅度，同时保留非旋转维度。修复了 #18262（YaRN 在 262K 以上被忽略）和 #19129。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19231
  • MLX CUDA 设备拒绝 — PR #19521（已关闭）提前拒绝不支持的 CUDA 架构，而不是在后续加载时以令人困惑的错误失败。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19521
  • MLX 上的 AutoTrust 决策模型 — PR #19399（已关闭）新增文本/视觉 AutoTrust 路由。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19399
  • WSL2 RTX Spark N1X GPU 显存发现 — PR #19520（开放中）修补了 WSL2 下统一内存笔记本的 GPU 显存检测。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19520
  • Linux/Windows 视频输入 — #19503（开放中）请求为 llama-server GGUF 模型支持 MP4/MOV（目前仅限 macOS/MLX）。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19503
  • 安装包体积 — #12268 和 #19512 提议拆分 GPU 运行时包（CUDA 12/13、ROCm、Vulkan、纯 CPU）以缩小 Linux/Windows 安装包。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/12268

性能与优化

  • 混合/SSM 模型的 VRAM 预测将 KV cache 高估 4–8 倍（Qwen3.5/3.8、Qwen3-Next），且忽略 OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE，始终按 f16 计算 — issue #19463（开放中）。导致 keep_alive=-1 的 runner 被过早驱逐。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19463
  • GGUF 拉取校验 — #19504 提议在并行 Range 下载过程中校验 blob，以避免拉取后昂贵的全量重新哈希（"verifying sha256 digest"）。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19504
  • SSE 流式刷新 — PR #17027（开放中）及时刷新 OpenAI 兼容的流式 chunk，以修复明显的 UI 卡顿（Chatbox/OpenWebUI）。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/17027
  • Apple Silicon GPU 显存文档 — PR #19527 记录了统一内存 GPU 上限及如何提高该上限。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19527
  • 推理期间防止休眠 — PR #19525（开放中）新增服务端休眠抑制。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19525

稳定性与回归

按严重程度排序：

  1. CUDA v13 语法约束崩溃 → Xid 79（GPU 掉总线） — #17026（开放中）。在 cuda_v13 上进行长时间 format 约束生成时崩溃；相同工作负载在 cuda_v12 上正常。最高严重级别（硬件级）。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/17026
  2. Windows RTX 5090 runner 在工具调用期间断连（HTTP 500 /tokenize） — #19439（开放中）。在 0.40.13 配合 Open WebUI 时间歇性出现。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19439
  3. Qwen2.5-Coder / Qwen3 在 0.40.13 上原生工具调用失败 — #19524（开放中）。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19524
  4. Responses API 在禁用截断的情况下仍静默截断超大输入 — #19492（开放中），在 0.40.13 和 0.40.14 上可复现。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19492
  5. GPU 上视觉推理 500 — qwen2.5vl:3b 在 GPU 视觉编码器上出现 "token repeat limit reached" 失败；CPU 正常。#19483（开放中）。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19483
  6. Qwen2.5 模板对 {{ .Function }} 渲染 Go 结构体转储而非 JSON — #19529（开放中）；工具名拼写错误，调用被丢弃。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19529
  7. 云端 /api/usage 回归 — #19511（开放中）：会话/每周百分比字段丢失，仅返回请求计数；可能为非预期回归。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19511
  8. 云端 deepseek-v4-pro 拒绝 max_tokens > 65536，尽管其输出能力约为 384k — #19517（开放中）。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19517
  9. 长期存在的 TLS 拉取失败 — #3504（开放中，自 2024 年 4 月起）：pull manifest TLS 握手超时，仍在复现。https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/3504

进行中的修复 PR：#19522（将工具结果文本+图像保留在单条消息中，修复 #19479）、#18767（按 tool_call_id 匹配工具结果组，修复 #18762）、#19526（旧版模板保留 helpers/define）、#19528（Modelfile FROM 引号往返）、#19408（限制 MLX System One 提示扩展，超大时返回 413）。

对应用开发者的意义

  • 工具调用目前是最脆弱的环节。 如果你在 Windows/GPU 上依赖 Qwen2.5/Qwen3 的原生工具调用，请锁定到已知良好的版本，并在服务端验证工具名保真度；模板 JSON 损坏（#19529）和 runner 断连（#19439）会表现为调用丢失或格式错误。
  • 并行工具结果需要 tool_call_id 匹配。 在 #18767 合入之前，对顺序敏感的后端可能会错误归因结果 — 请按调用顺序发送工具结果或在客户端进行规范化。
  • Responses API 截断是静默的（#19492）：请在客户端强制实施输入长度检查，而不是依赖服务端截断标志。
  • 混合/SSM 模型的容量估算不可靠（#19463）：请保守预留 VRAM，在修复前不要假设 OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE 会被遵循。
  • 云端用量遥测的形态已改变（#19511、#12532）：不要在仪表板中硬编码百分比字段；API 可能仅提供请求计数。
  • 流式客户端应容忍延迟的 chunk 交付，直到 #17027 合入 — 长时间的明显卡顿可能是缓冲造成的，而非推理停滞。
LiteLLM — BerriAI/litellm

LiteLLM 摘要 — 2026-11-05

1. 今日亮点

LiteLLM 在过去 24 小时内发布了三个版本（v1.108.0 稳定版、v1.106.7 补丁版、v1.109.0-rc.1），全部以 cosign 镜像签名验证作为发布门槛。问题队列仍以流式正确性与计费准确性缺陷为主——客户端提前断开、流中途回退以及预算窗口核算都在产生静默的成本/配额缺口。一个包含 9 个 PR 的大型“控制平面”堆栈（数据平面注册表、OCSF 审计事件、SIEM 接收器、集群聚合）正在积极评审中，标志着向多数据平面集群管理推进。

2. 版本发布与破坏性变更

版本 说明
v1.108.0 稳定版。所有 Docker 镜像（litellm、litellm-database、litellm-non_root、docker.io/litellm/*）现已使用 cosign 签名；请使用提交 e82a3c6 中的密钥进行验证。发布说明
v1.106.7 1.106 系列的补丁版本，使用相同的 cosign 验证命令。发布说明
v1.109.0-rc.1 候选发布版——签名情况相同；预计 API 表面变更将在此版本稳定。发布说明

需关注的模型映射回归： eu.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 已从 model_prices_and_context_window.json 及 #49113/23595f7fe 中的模型映射中移除，但 AWS 仍将其作为 EU 推理配置文件提供——固定使用该 ID 的部署将解析失败。#49312

3. 新模型与硬件支持

  • 现有 DashScope 提供商请求支持 QwenCloud 迁移路径（Qwen、Wan、CosyVoice 的 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兼容端点）。#36150 — 已关闭。
  • Cloudflare Workers AI 图像和音频支持请求因过期/重复而关闭——不会落地。#35055、#35056
  • 提议以 Rust 路由核心替代 Python 核心，仅以宿主作为边界（PythonHost 桥接，无原生执行器路径）。评审中。#49513
  • 今日未出现新的 CUDA/ROCm/Metal 或量化格式相关工作。

4. 性能与优化

  • MCP tools/list 延迟回归： 从 v1.106.6 升级到 v1.108.0 后，对于发送 2026 之前协议版本的 notifications/initialized 的客户端（例如 Python mcp SDK 的 ClientSession，Open WebUI 使用的就是它），通过 /mcp/ 的 tools/list 会阻塞 18–50 秒——追踪到遗留订阅监听器。#50065
  • 最小繁忙路由踩踏修复： 同时到达的请求读取到相同的在途计数并全部涌向同一部署；该 PR 在选择时预留每次选择，使下一个请求将其视为繁忙。#47484
  • 健康探针驱逐上下文： 在针对 262k 上下文本地模型、并发为 1 的情况下，健康检查据报告会导致上下文驱逐，并随上下文填满而出现周期性延迟尖峰。#49930
  • 工具循环中的提示缓存未命中： /v1/messages → Vertex Claude 在 system/tools 之前发送 messages，破坏了工具循环轮次间的提示缓存命中。#50070

5. 稳定性与回归

严重——计费/用量正确性：

  • 提前断开时流式用量丢失： 如果客户端在最终用量块之前中止，该请求的所有 token/成本跟踪都会被丢弃——造成计费缺口和配额不准确。对任何计量部署均为高严重性。#14457（开放）
  • 预算窗口支出丢弃在途请求： 在请求进行中执行 /key/update 意味着该请求的成本永远不会计入 LiteLLM_BudgetWindowSpend（支出日志和密钥 spend 是正确的；只有窗口总额错误）。#49179 — 已关闭。
  • 并发下的会话预算绕过： 准入检查记录了支出但未为在途调用预留容量，因此并发请求可能超出 max_budget_per_session。#34732（开放）
  • 自 #49532 起自定义按调用价格丢失区域/速度乘数 — OpenAI 数据驻留、Vertex 区域和 Anthropic 地理路由的加价全部被丢弃。修复 PR：#50063。相关批量缓存定价回退：#50062。

高——流式/回退正确性：

  • 仅推理前缀后回退丢失： sent_first_chunk 在任何增量（包括推理）时翻转，因此思考期间的中流故障被误报为首块之后，即使客户端未收到任何内容也会跳过回退。#49795（开放）
  • SSE 保活在上游故障前提交 200： 使用 sse_keepalive_ping_interval_seconds 时，第一个 : ping 即提交响应，因此后续上游错误只能写入响应体——/v1/messages 上的 Anthropic 客户端会收到 SSE 错误载荷而非正常的失败。#49711（开放）
  • Responses 桥接在 /v1/chat/completions 流式传输中重复工具调用参数（针对 azure/responses）：第一个增量携带完整参数 JSON，随后参数增量再次发送片段。#48773 — 已关闭。
  • Anthropic server_tool_use 被呈现为待定 tool_call 导致代理客户端循环（finish_reason 为 stop，同时包含 content 和 tool_calls）。#48384（开放）

中——翻译/提供商边缘情况：

  • chatgpt/ 提供商在 /v1/messages 上丢弃加密推理 → 工具调用之间从不重放。#49046
  • Azure Messages→Responses 绕行在恢复的工具调用历史中丢弃加密推理（#40451 的后续）。#50024
  • Bedrock Converse 向非 Anthropic 模型（例如 zai.glm-5.3）重放 reasoningText.signature → 400。#49969
  • Groq 在流式推理回复后拒绝历史记录，因为 reasoning_content 被回显。#47931 — 已关闭。
  • Databricks 仅工具响应（无 content 键）在 resolve_reasoning_and_content 中引发 KeyError。#48637
  • text.format: json_schema 被原样转发给仅支持 json_object 的提供商 → 400 被呈现为 500。#49198
  • bedrock/openai 调用路由忽略 model_id（应用程序推理配置文件 ARN）→ 400 Unknown parameter。#49083
  • OTel set_attributes 对非字典响应（DecisionsResponse、MCP CallToolResult、列表）调用 .get() → 崩溃。#48719
  • 粘性会话未生效——路由器发送到不同端点。#50029

护栏：

  • 通过 Anthropic /v1/messages 发送的 MCP 工具对 pre_call 中的 custom_code 和 tool_permission 护栏不可见——无法检查或阻止它们。#40583 — 已关闭。
  • 流式多选完成会一起检查所有选项的工具调用，导致掩码遗漏和错误的按选项限制触发。修复 PR：#46860。

6. 对应用开发者的意义

  1. 不要信任中止流的用量数字。 如果你的应用会取消流式请求（超时、用户导航、代理步骤预算），这些 token 可能永远不会被计费或计入配额。在 #14457 落地之前请为此缺口做预算，并避免将 LiteLLM 侧支出作为基于用量定价的唯一真实来源。
  2. 流中推理回退不可靠。 对于推理模型，“思考”期间的提供商故障不会触发你配置的回退（#49795），而启用保活的流无法干净地呈现上游错误（#49711）。如果你需要弹性的推理模型服务，优先使用非流式或在客户端实现重试/回退。
  3. 固定模型 ID，验证镜像。 v1.108.0 是稳定版；Claude Haiku EU 推理配置文件的移除（#49312）对任何使用区域 Bedrock ID 的人都是活生生的陷阱。在推广前验证 cosign 签名——这现在是文档化的发布契约。
  4. 代理循环 UX 回归是真实存在的。 Anthropic server_tool_use 作为待定 tool_call（#48384）以及 chatgpt/ 路径上丢失加密推理（#49046、#50024）都会导致 Claude Code 风格客户端在 /v1/messages 上循环或丢失推理历史。如果你将代理流量路由到 Anthropic 兼容端点，请显式测试工具循环。
  5. MCP 网关延迟： 如果你升级到 v1.108.0 并使用 Python SDK 客户端配合 MCP，预期会出现数十秒的 tools/list 停滞（#50065）——如果 MCP 发现位于你的关键路径上，请固定 v1.106.6 或等待修复。
  6. 控制平面方向： 这个 9-PR 堆栈（数据平面注册表 → 扇出聚合 → 审计/OCSF/Splunk/Sentinel/S3-Object-Lock 接收器 → OTel span）指向一个未来：一个 LiteLLM 控制平面管理多个数据平面。如果你运行多集群网关集群，值得关注；目前尚无可用内容。从 #49655 开始。

  • 多 GPU 扩散（FLUX.1/FLUX.2）：自动选择配对显卡并复制到第二张卡（#16682、#16687）。
  • HunyuanVideo-1.5 小主机规划器修复，适用于 15 GB 显卡 / 31 GB 主机（Kaggle T4）（#16700）。
  • Qwen-Image 现在在显存允许时自动保留 bf16 文本编码器（#16678）。
  • 涉及的后端：CUDA、MLX（更快的加载）、FP8、GGUF。

4. 性能与优化

  • generate() 中默认启用 CUDA-graph 解码（#16691）：Qwen3-0.6B 每步启动约 675 个 kernel（使用 LoRA 时为 1070–1430）；在 T4 上，GPU 在每个 30–75 ms 的步骤中仅有部分时间处于忙碌状态。捕获的解码与 eager 模式逐位相等，并支持内存释放和 eager 回退。
  • RoPE kernel Triton 特化修复（#16690）：将 seqlen 标记为非特化，以避免解码（len=1）与预填充之间产生重复的 kernel 变体。
  • SDXL 管线加载：在 L4 上从 24–25 秒提速，通过一次性读取 v-prediction 标记并跳过 UNet scheme 探测（节省约 6 秒）（#16696）。
  • Qwen-Image 质量/延迟：int8 ConvRot 编码器是相对于 bf16 的 LPIPS 差距的主要来源（均值 0.0865，最差提示词 0.401）；常驻时自动使用 bf16（#16678）。
  • v0.1.915-beta 中更低的空闲内存 + 更快的 MLX 加载。
  • API 提供商的 tok/s 徽章（#16506）以及 自定义连接的真实 token 用量/上下文窗口（#16505）——可观测性改进。

5. 稳定性与回归

按严重程度排序：

  1. 长对话下的 UI 卡顿（Web + 桌面端） — 未解决的回归，尚无修复 PR（#16603）。
  2. search_conversation 工具消失（第 2 次和第 3 次出现） — 反复出现；关闭后再次出现表明修复不完整（#16602、#16706）。
  3. 聊天模板丢弃任意 chat_template_kwargs（仅 3 个键能通过；例如会破坏 Sage-A1.5 的 verification）（#16545，已关闭）。
  4. gemma-4-thinking 聊天模板移除推理内容（#16699）。
  5. Studio web_search 始终显示 "No results found" — 缺少 Accept 头（DDG 202）+ yandex 未在允许列表中（#16664）。
  6. S3 音频摄取正确性：单记录 .json 清单跳过路径重写（#16630）；前缀根冲突会静默选择错误的录音（#16528）——静默的训练数据损坏。
  7. 微调任务 API 在新任务启动时丢弃已取消的排队任务（#16632）。
  8. 混合 ShareGPT + 原生工具调用丢失工具调用元数据（#16051，已关闭）。
  9. AppImage 在 Slackware64-current 上失败（GLib/AppIndicator 符号查找）（#16605）。
  10. 原生量化测试的顺序依赖问题已修复（#16704，已关闭）；另有若干桌面端更新失败报告（#16573、#16561，已关闭）。

6. 对应用开发者的意义

  • 本地服务默认免费提速：纯 generate() 中的 CUDA-graph 解码路径逐位相同，并可通过 eager 回退选择退出——预计在消费级 GPU（T4 级别）上无需修改代码即可获得显著的 tok/s 提升。
  • 固定 transformers <5.23，直到 checkpointing 重命名被完全吸收；Trainer 的行为变化可能静默改变训练结果。
  • 不要轻信表面上的聊天模板行为：chat_template_kwargs 过滤意味着提供商特定的标志（例如 verification/agentic 模式）会被丢弃——如果你依赖它们，请进行端到端验证。
  • 网关集成：远程提供商的自定义请求头仍不受支持（#14811，已关闭）——请相应地规划 LiteLLM 风格的追踪/特征选择请求头；自定义连接的用量/上下文报告正在改进。
  • Agent 工具：浏览器脚本执行将获得 "Always allow" 选项（#16707）——与无人值守 agent 相关；沙箱粒度请求（#16625）和持久化项目/agent 记忆（#10775）预示着 agent 平台的发展方向。
  • 训练管线：推送数据集前请审查 S3/单记录清单处理——这两个音频 bug 会在不报错的情况下产生错误的训练对。

本日报由 agents-radar 自动生成。

item.content:encoded:
AI Infrastructure Digest 2026-11-05

Generated: 2026-11-04 23:22 UTC | Projects covered: 6

  • vLLM
  • SGLang
  • llama.cpp
  • Ollama
  • LiteLLM
  • Unsloth

Cross-Project Comparison

Cross-Project Comparison Report — AI Infrastructure Digest

Date: 2026-11-05 | Prepared for infrastructure engineers and technical decision-makers

1. Ecosystem Overview

Today's landscape shows a two-tier market operating in tension. The high-throughput serving engines (vLLM, SGLang) are in a hardening phase: no releases shipped, but maturity is being tested by serious correctness bugs — cross-request KV contamination in P/D disaggregation, silent KV-page-stride corruption in Mooncake paths, and multi-model release-tag regressions. Simultaneously, the local/edge runtime (llama.cpp) shipped its v0.9.0 kernel-level release (flash_attn_ext_rows, FP8 E4M3), while the gateway (LiteLLM) and training (Unsloth) layers focused on billing/streaming correctness and CUDA-graph decode acceleration, respectively. The common thread across all five projects: reasoning-model behavior and P/D + cache infrastructure are where failures now concentrate, and correctness — not raw throughput — is the dominant risk for production deployments.

2. Activity Comparison

Project Layer Issues Activity PR Activity Release Status (24h)
vLLM Serving engine High — dominated by DeepSeek-V4/V4.1, Qwen3.8 bring-up; 1 CRITICAL open bug Active — perf PRs (KV checksums, Triton vectorization), model portfolios No release. v0.32.0 flagged as risky (regression trio)
SGLang Serving engine High (61 updated) Very high (500 updated) — heaviest PR throughput No release. FlashInfer 0.7.3 migration in flight (breaking)
llama.cpp Local runtime Moderate — Intel GPU regression cluster Active — backend tuning (OpenCL, Vulkan, HIP) v0.9.0 shipped (b12110+): FP8 E4M3, flash_attn_ext_rows, 4 architectures
Ollama Local runtime / distribution High — tool-calling + API-correctness regressions on v0.40.13/14 Moderate — fix PRs on tool-result handling, SSE flush No release. CUDA v13 grammar crash (Xid 79) is highest-severity open item
LiteLLM Gateway Very high — streaming/billing correctness dominates Active — 9-PR "control plane" stack in review 3 releases: v1.108.0 (stable), v1.106.7 (patch), v1.109.0-rc.1 — all cosign-signed
Unsloth Fine-tuning / training Moderate — desktop/Studio regressions Active — CUDA-graph decode, multi-GPU diffusion v0.1.915-beta (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, Glass themes)

Read-out: LiteLLM is the most release-active (3 releases, all signature-gated); llama.cpp and Unsloth shipped meaningful version bumps; the two heavyweight serving engines shipped nothing — both are absorbing breaking migrations or fixing critical correctness bugs. SGLang's PR volume (500) dwarfs all others, indicating unusually heavy in-flight refactoring.

3. Model Support Race

Model / Architecture vLLM SGLang llama.cpp Ollama Unsloth
DeepSeek-V4 / V4.1 ✅ Bring-up active (but SM8x missing; block-size broken on v0.32.0) ✅ TRTLLM sparse MLA, FP8 KV layout — — —
Qwen3.8 family (2.4T-A95B, Flash-Next) ✅ AMD gfx950 trackers + optimizations ✅ HiCache backup (with known bug #48145) — — ✅ Flash-Next in v0.1.915-beta
Kimi K3.1 Pro / K3 ✅ Broad PR (ROCm, spec decode, Rust, Mooncake/NIXL) ✅ PCP KV sharding + HiCache + DFlash — — —
GLM-5.2 / 5.3 ✅ Optimization tracker ✅ Breakable prefill CUDA graphs — — —
Mistral Large 4 — — ✅ v0.9.0 — —
Clover / Limite / Metis-1.6 — — ✅ v0.9.0 (4 architectures) — —
Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 🔶 Requested (#47455) — — — —
Drama-3 TTS — — ✅ Audio support (b12116) — —
Inception Mercury (diffusion LLM) — — — — ✅ Preset + live streaming
Qwen3 / 3.5 (YaRN, RoPE) — — — ✅ MLX YaRN scaling —

Who's ahead:

  • Serving engines (vLLM, SGLang) are locked in a frontier-model arms race — both are racing on the same new flagships (DeepSeek-V4, Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, GLM-5.x). vLLM is ahead on breadth of hardware backends (ROCm, Rust frontend, Mooncake/NIXL); SGLang is ahead on deep architectural integration (TRTLLM sparse MLA, PCP KV sharding).
  • llama.cpp owns the broad-tail architecture adoption niche — 4 new architectures + audio + new dense/ternary models in a single release. It is the clear leader for model-format coverage breadth.
  • Unsloth is the fastest to fine-tuning presets for new diffusion LLMs and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.
  • Gap signal: vLLM's Ampere (SM8x) support for DeepSeek-V4 remains open (#50576) — a meaningful capacity-planning constraint for cost-sensitive fleets.

4. Performance Frontier

The optimization effort is concentrated in KV cache and disaggregation, with kernels and quantization close behind. Distribution of effort across the layer stack:

KV cache & P/D disaggregation (highest activity, highest risk):

  • vLLM: connector-agnostic KV checksums (#62211), MooncakeConnector RFC, scheduler stall elimination (1.0–1.8s).
  • SGLang: Mooncake page-stride fix, Kimi-K3 PCP KV sharding, HiCache host-tier work — but this is also where the most dangerous bugs live (silent corruption).
  • llama.cpp: flash_attn_ext_rows for efficient unified-KV multi-sequence serving — a foundational primitive.

Kernels & attention:

  • Triton KV-slot vectorization (vLLM #62113), AITER prefill attention on gfx950 (9.3s → 4.1s on MI350X, SGLang), FP8-Q ASM MLA verify (P90 ITL 6.77ms → 6.18ms, SGLang), Vulkan Intel prefill FA kernel (llama.cpp).

CUDA graphs & decode loops:

  • Unsloth's CUDA-graph decode by default in generate() (bitwise-identical, ~675 kernels/step eliminated on Qwen3-0.6B) is today's most under-appreciated win — a free speedup for T4-class consumer hardware. SGLang extends breakable prefill CUDA graphs to interleave CP prefill.

Quantization:

  • llama.cpp OCP FP8 E4M3 (v0.9.0) + CUDA TQ2_0 for ternary/BitNet models. vLLM ModelOpt FP8/NVFP4 weight-only embeddings rebase. Unsloth FP8 + int8-vs-bf16 ConvRot analysis (quality gap quantified at LPIPS 0.0865).

Distributed serving & AMD/ROCm (emerging theme):

  • Both serving engines are investing heavily in AMD gfx950/MI355X — vLLM's Qwen3.8 AMD trackers and SGLang's AITER/MLA wins signal ROCm is moving from "supported" to "optimized." FlashInfer 0.7.3's removal of MoeAlltoAll is a forced migration for SGLang's NVLink one-sided all-to-all.

Net: Optimization ROI is still highest in KV/disaggregation data movement — but that same region is where today's most severe correctness risks live.

5. Layer Positioning

Layer Project(s) Core Function Primary Optimization Axis Risk Profile
Serving engine (cluster) vLLM, SGLang Max-throughput multi-tenant inference, P/D disaggregation, prefix caching KV movement, batching, kernel fusion, large-model bring-up Highest blast radius — single bugs (KV contamination, corruption) affect many tenants; critical data-leak class
Local runtime llama.cpp, Ollama Single-node/edge inference, GGUF distribution, consumer hardware Architecture coverage, quantization formats, backend kernels (OpenCL/Vulkan/Hexagon) Correctness on non-NVIDIA backends (Intel Vulkan nondeterminism); Ollama adds distribution/tooling surface
Gateway LiteLLM Multi-provider routing, billing, quotas, guardrails, observability Correctness of usage accounting, streaming/fallback semantics, fleet control plane Billing/quota correctness — silent cost gaps; agent-loop UX regressions
Training / fine-tuning Unsloth LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning, diffusion model training, presets Decode kernel capture, memory footprint, checkpoint compat Training-data corruption (S3 manifest bugs) and framework-rename drift

Key distinctions for decision-makers:

  • vLLM vs SGLang are substitutes competing on the same layer — vLLM leads on hardware breadth and ecosystem (Rust frontend, NIXL), SGLang leads on deep model-specific kernel integration and AMD determinism. Choosing between them increasingly means choosing a release cadence and bug-surface profile.
  • llama.cpp vs Ollama: llama.cpp is the engine; Ollama is the distribution + API + UX layer built on it. Many Ollama regressions (tool calling, Responses API) are its own plumbing, not llama.cpp.
  • LiteLLM is the only control-plane layer in this set, and it is the only one shipping stable releases today — reflecting a different maturity phase (operational stability vs frontier model chasing).
  • Unsloth sits upstream (model creation) and increasingly overlaps serving (CUDA-graph decode, browser agents) — watch this convergence.

6. Trend Signals — What to Watch

Trend 1 — P/D disaggregation is production-ready in design, but not yet in correctness. Both serving engines have severe, silent-failure bugs in disaggregated KV paths: vLLM cross-request contamination (#61160, data-leak class) and SGLang Mooncake stride corruption (#48230). Watch: whether --no-enable-prefix-caching-style mitigations become standard defaults. Agent/app developers: if you run P/D, disable prefix caching until #61160 lands and audit router versions (#31206 dead-prefill).

Trend 2 — The "release tag regression" problem is acute. vLLM v0.32.0 has a regression trio; Ollama v0.40.13/14 broke native tool calling. Watch: pinning discipline. App developers: the safest release is frequently the previous one (vLLM v0.31.1 is the recommended pin for long-context Qwen). Build pinning into deployment, not into hope.

Trend 3 — Reasoning models stress every layer of the streaming stack. LiteLLM's streamed-reasoning fallback bugs (#49795), SGLang's EAGLE PD decode corruption, and vLLM's reasoning-parser whitespace bug all stem from reasoning-token handling. Watch: SGLang's new time-to-first-answer-token histogram (#48466) — this separates reasoning latency from answer latency and is the right observability primitive for reasoning SLOs. Adopt it.

Trend 4 — AMD/ROCm is graduating from "supported" to "optimized." gfx950/MI355X appears across vLLM (Qwen3.8 trackers), SGLang (AITER, MLA), llama.cpp (HIP fast-math). Watch: for regulated/reproducibility workloads, SGLang's deterministic-mode AITER prefill is notable. For capacity planning, AMD is a credible Hopper/Blackwell alternative now for specific models.

Trend 5 — Gateway ↔ agent-loop interoperability is fragile. LiteLLM's server_tool_use-as-pending-toolcall (#48384), dropped encrypted reasoning (#49046), and Ollama's tool-template JSON corruption (#19529) all break Claude-Code-style agent clients. Watch: tool-call ID matching (Ollama #18767) and explicit parser pinning (SGLang --tool-call-parser auto unreliable, #48172). Agent developers: never rely on auto-detection in production — pin explicit parsers and normalize tool results client-side.

Trend 6 — Control-plane consolidation is coming. LiteLLM's 9-PR stack (dataplane registry → OCSF audit → SIEM sinks → OTel spans) points to one control plane governing many dataplanes — a fleet-management future. Nothing to adopt yet, but multi-cluster gateway operators should track #49655.

Trend 7 — Free performance is still shipping at the edge. Unsloth's bitwise-equal CUDA-graph decode and llama.cpp's flash_attn_ext_rows both deliver no-code-change gains on consumer/edge hardware. App developers: local serving is quietly getting faster; re-benchmark before scaling cloud capacity for latency-sensitive local workloads.

Bottom line for decision-makers

  • Cluster serving: hold on vLLM v0.32.0 for DeepSeek/long-context; disable P/D + prefix caching until critical KV bugs close. SGLang offers deeper AMD determinism but carries more in-flight breaking migrations (FlashInfer 0.7.3, api.v1).
  • Edge/local: upgrade llama.cpp to v0.9.0 (validate FP8 E4M3); tighten -hf quant tags; avoid Intel Vulkan coopmat for classifiers.
  • Gateway: v1.108.0 is stable with cosign verification as the contract — but do not trust usage counts for aborted streams, and pin model IDs (EU Haiku profile removal is a live footgun).
  • Training: pin transformers <5.23 until the checkpointing rename is absorbed; audit S3/audio manifests for silent data corruption.

Per-Project Reports

vLLM — vllm-project/vllm

vLLM Digest — 2026-11-05

1. Today's Highlights

No new releases landed in the last 24 hours, but issue activity is dominated by DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 and Qwen3.8-class model bring-up, with several correctness regressions surfacing on SM120 (Blackwell) and in P/D-disaggregated deployments. A potentially serious KV-cache cross-request contamination bug in prefix-cached P/D setups (#61160) remains open, while new perf PRs target KV-transfer verification and Triton attention vectorization. AMD continues pushing gfx950/MI355X optimization trackers for the Qwen3.8 family.

2. Releases & Breaking Changes

No new releases in the last 24h. Relevant compatibility notes from open items:

  • v0.32.0 regression trio: block-size failures on the release tag for DeepSeek-V4.1 (#59203), Qwen4Exp 262K-prefill CUDA illegal memory access that works on v0.31.1 (#62383), and SM120 rejection of enable_adaptive_verification (#63343) — users on v0.31.x may want to hold upgrades pending fixes.
  • PR to ship missing vllm/utils/numa_wrapper.sh in wheels — NUMA-bound launches abort at startup on git-less builds (#65756).
  • Default CUDA build moving 13.0 → 13.2 to match pinned torch 2.13.0 wheels (#55387).

3. New Model & Hardware Support

  • SM8x (A100/A800, RTX 30xx) support for DeepSeek-V4-Flash / -0731 — hottest issue of the day (128 comments); neither checkpoint runs on Ampere today (#50576).
  • Kimi K3.1 Pro model PR opened with a very broad tag footprint (ROCm, spec decode, KV connectors, Rust frontend, Mooncake/NIXL) (#65685).
  • RDNA 3.5 (gfx115x) hybrid W4A16 MoE backend — fused HIP decode + Triton prefill (#65754).
  • NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming (0.6B) support requested (#47455).
  • ModelOpt FP8/NVFP4 weight-only embeddings loading PR rebased (#42791).
  • Rust frontend tokenizer parity test covering 8 tokenizers / 35 recipes, with two pinned divergences (#65757).

4. Performance & Optimization

  • GLM-5.3 optimization tracker (same glm_moe_dsa base as 5.2) (#57406).
  • Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next gfx950/MI355X optimization plans landing as stacked PRs on AMD (#57149, #59575).
  • Batch-invariant mode on Hopper/Blackwell reportedly routes Linear layers to Triton even though cuBLAS is already batch-invariant under the mode — avoidable perf loss (#65569).
  • 16-byte-aligned per-token-head KV slots so Triton vectorizes loads in TRITON_ATTN; measured on RTX 3080 for int8/fp8 paths (#62113).
  • Connector-agnostic KV checksums for P/D disaggregation — producer/consumer checksum match, mismatch treated as KV load failure (#62211).
  • Scheduler: eliminating 1.0–1.8s re-queueing stall for completed async KV pulls via front-of-queue re-admission (#62532).
  • MooncakeConnector RFC — primary P/D path on non-CUDA platforms (RDMA/TCP/Ascend) (#60523).

5. Stability & Regressions

Ranked by severity:

  1. CRITICAL — Cross-request context contamination in PD disaggregation + automatic prefix caching (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash): responses intermittently contain other requests' content; scriptable reproducer; workaround --no-enable-prefix-caching (#61160).
  2. HIGH — Qwen4Exp 262K single-prefill CUDA illegal memory access on v0.32.0 and nightly, OK on v0.31.1 (#62383).
  3. HIGH — No working block size on v0.32.0 for DeepSeek-V4.1 (both 64 and 128 fail); fix tracked in #60762 (#59203).
  4. MEDIUM — DSpark draft 0% acceptance for DeepSeek-V4 due to missing packed_modules_mapping; fused layers ignore ignored_layers (#65618).
  5. MEDIUM — SM120 rejects enable_adaptive_verification (device-query-lens gated to SM90/SM100) (#63343).
  6. MEDIUM — Batch-invariance drift on Qwen3.6 GDN greedy DFlash2 under preemption/recompute (#62851).
  7. LOW–MEDIUM — torch.compile stride-mismatch crash at warmup for Qwen3.5/Qwen3-Next GDN attention (recurrence of #29014) (#50046).
  8. LOW — --reasoning-parser qwen3 leaves leading \n\n in content after stripping <think> (#61972).
  9. FIXED/CLOSED — Non-streaming client disconnect not detected; engine runs to max_tokens and tokens count as delivered (#61918).
  10. CLOSED — PR fixing multimodal dummy-input validation against mm limits (Pixtral embedding-only startup) (#65689).

6. What This Means for Application Developers

  • If you run P/D disaggregation with prefix caching, disable it until #61160 is fixed. Cross-request crosstalk is a data-leak class bug, not just a quality bug.
  • Treat v0.32.0 with caution for DeepSeek-V4 and long-context Qwen deployments; v0.31.1 is the safer pin for the 262K-prefill case, and block-size configs on the release tag are broken.
  • Ampere owners should not expect DeepSeek-V4-Flash until #50576 lands — plan capacity on Hopper/Blackwell or AMD MI355X instead.
  • Batch-invariant mode has an avoidable perf tax on Hopper/Blackwell; if you rely on it for reproducible evals, benchmark against defaults before assuming it's free.
  • KV checksums (#62211) will give you a correctness backstop for multi-node P/D transfers — worth tracking if you operate NIXL/Mooncake topologies.
  • Request-ID-only logging (#64654) is still pending; if you need gateway-to-engine correlation without content logging, it isn't available natively yet.
  • Smaller wins: the wheel-shipping fix (#65756) matters if you build vLLM from source without .git; pin to a fixed release once available.
SGLang — sgl-project/sglang

SGLang Digest — 2026-11-05

1. Today's Highlights

No new releases landed in the last 24 hours, but issue and PR activity stayed high (61 updated issues, 500 updated PRs). The dominant themes are PD disaggregation correctness (a router circuit-breaker bug, a Mooncake KV-page-stride mismatch, an EAGLE decode corruption after retraction) and AMD/Hopper kernel tuning via AITER and FlashInfer 0.7.3. On the infra side, the CI flakes tracker (#42752, now 176 comments) and the Q4 PD disaggregation roadmap (#43699) remain the most active coordination threads.

2. Releases & Breaking Changes

No new releases today. Two forward-looking items with migration implications:

  • RFC: Complete migration to the shared api.v1 backend API (#45816) — moves sgl-processor, sgl-router, and the Rust server onto a unified api.v1.Generate schema. Expect interface churn in the router/processor path.
  • FlashInfer bump to 0.7.3 + flashinfer.moe_ep migration (#48468) — 0.7.3 removes flashinfer.comm.MoeAlltoAll, so the bump and the NVLink one-sided all-to-all migration must land together. Relevant if you build against FlashInfer's MoE comm APIs.

3. New Model & Hardware Support

  • Kimi-K3.1 PCP KV sharding with HiCache + DFlash (#48469) — shards persistent DSA KV pages across ranks instead of replicating, assembled for TRTLLM DSA attention.
  • Muse Spark Open cookbook: TPU v7 (#48277) — single host, 4 chips / 8 TensorCores, --tp-size 8 serving NVFP4 via SGLang-TorchTPU.
  • GLM-5.2 / GLM-5.3 (GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM): breakable prefill CUDA graphs extended under interleave context-parallel prefill with fp8 KV + trtllm kernels (#46890).
  • DeepSeek-V4 TRTLLM sparse MLA: caller-owned multi-CTA KV counter buffer replacing a private FlashInfer workaround (#48467); this also unblocks the PD-disaggregation uniform-FP8 KV layout request (#37838, now closed inactive).

4. Performance & Optimization

  • AMD AITER prefill attention on gfx950 in deterministic mode (#45601) — on MI350X, Qwen3-8B @ 32k input drops Triton prefill attention from 9.3s → 4.1s with AITER batch prefill.
  • Kimi-K3 12-head MLA on gfx950 (FP8 KV) (#45320) — moving decode + 8-token verify to fp8-Q ASM improves P90 ITL from 6.77ms → 6.18ms on AgentX c1 traffic.
  • Paged experts without staging copy (#48082) — reduces host memory footprint during checkpoint load by eliminating the pageable staging duplication.
  • --routed-experts-dtype int16 (#47833) — halves the routed-expert host cache for --enable-return-routed-experts.
  • LingBot-Video MoE TMA tuning for B300 (#48470) — MoE is ~39% of summed kernel time at 832×480×81; enabling existing up/down TMA paths targets that region.
  • Diffusion: image-prefix sequence parallelism for ERNIE-Image (#48218) — fixes 4D spatial latent sharding that previously failed Ulysses2 requests pre-execution.

5. Stability & Regressions

Ranked by severity:

  1. Router circuit breaker dispatches to a dead decode, creating a permanently fake-dead prefill (#31206) — sgl-router v0.2.4 PD mode; a single stuck prefill can poison cluster state. No fix PR referenced; open since July.
  2. Mooncake PD: mismatched KV page stride silently corrupts decode KV and overruns layer buffers (#48231, fixes #48230) — fix PR open. High impact: silent corruption, not a crash.
  3. Qwen EAGLE PD decode produces corrupted output after retraction (#48356) — new yesterday; no fix PR yet.
  4. DSpark + TP: grammar-constrained request batched with any other request deadlocks all ranks (#41449) — collective hang, both overlap and non-overlap modes.
  5. HiCache on hybrid GDN: host-tier hits drop to zero past ~3 long prefixes (#45400) — host mamba pool exhaustion while KV remains on host; prefix-cache capacity cliff for long-context hybrid models.
  6. Mooncake HiCache backup fails for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 (#48145) and mamba lazy boundary snapshot overwrites the keep slot (#48328, fix PR open) — checkpointing integrity in hybrid/Mamba paths.
  7. --tool-call-parser auto finds no parser on Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen3 2507, Ling-mini-2.0 (#48172) — tool calls return as plain text; affects agent integrations on smaller models.
  8. DSV4 prefill throughput gap on SM120 (#33422) — ~2–7K tok/s vs ~12.5K with vLLM/marlin on 4× RTX PRO 6000; still unresolved, tuning guidance requested.

6. What This Means for Application Developers

  • If you run PD disaggregation, audit your router version and Mooncake registration path: #31206 and #48231 are both silent-failure classes (one permanent dead-prefill state, one KV corruption). If you use EAGLE under PD, watch #48356 before rolling out retraction-heavy workloads.
  • Tool-calling agents: --tool-call-parser auto is unreliable on several smaller/base models (#48172). Pin an explicit parser in production rather than relying on auto-detection.
  • Long-context hybrid-model users: the HiCache host-tier cliff (#45400) means prefix reuse degrades sharply once evicted working sets exceed a few long prefixes — size host mamba pools and long-prefix concurrency accordingly.
  • AMD MI3xx/ROCm deployments are getting real attention: deterministic-mode prefill attention and MLA verify kernels now have concrete latency wins in review, which matters for reproducibility-sensitive regulated workloads.
  • Observability: a new time-to-first-answer-token histogram (#48466) will separate reasoning-token latency from answer latency — worth adopting for reasoning-model SLOs once merged.
llama.cpp — ggml-org/llama.cpp

llama.cpp Digest — 2026-11-05

1. Today's Highlights

llama.cpp shipped v0.9.0, headlined by OCP FP8 E4M3 quantization, a new flash_attn_ext_rows op enabling efficient unified-KV multi-sequence inference, and a generic batched tensor copy API. Alongside this, four new architectures landed (Clover, Limite, Metis-1.6, Mistral Large 4), plus audio support for Drama-3 TTS. The release cycle was otherwise dominated by backend tuning (OpenCL/Adreno, Vulkan Intel) and a cluster of Intel GPU correctness/regression reports still under triage.

2. Releases & Breaking Changes

  • v0.9.0 (b12110 bumps the version): https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases — adds OCP FP8 E4M3 quant, flash_attn_ext_rows, batched tensor copy API, 4 new architectures, audio, Drama-3 TTS (b12116).
  • Unified KV cache efficiency for multi-sequence inference via flash_attn_ext_rows — relevant to anyone running llama-server with --parallel N>1; this is a capability change worth validating against your batching paths.
  • -hf quant tag matching fix (b12100): tags like :F16 no longer match BF16, and :Q4_XS no longer matches IQ4_XS (now token-boundary anchored). If your tooling relied on loose tag matching, pin exact quant tags. https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31620
  • Server realtime hardening (b12119): websocket handlers now route through ex_wrapper and emit error events instead of crashing on exceptions — behavior change for clients that previously saw a dropped connection on malformed tool schemas (see #31626). https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31632

3. New Model & Hardware Support

  • New architectures: Clover, Limite, Metis-1.6, Mistral Large 4 (v0.9.0).
  • Drama-3 TTS audio support in mtmd (b12116): https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31613
  • ricursiveAI Ripple‑65B (new dense architecture, converter + graph, no new ops) — open PR: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31692
  • CUDA TQ2_0 dequant + MMVQ for ternary models (BitNet b1.58, BitCPM, Falcon3-1.58bit) so weights stay on GPU instead of CPU fallback — open PR: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30278
  • Hexagon SIN/COS/MEAN ops — open PR: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31674
  • WebGPU: group norm and timestep embedding kernels (for stable-diffusion.cpp downstream) — PRs #31490, #31695
  • SpacemiT vendor instruction prefixing for upstream binutils compatibility — PR #31677
  • Long-running request: XDNA backend (#21725, 37 comments, 39 👍) still open.

4. Performance & Optimization

  • OpenCL decode perf with FA (b12118): more workgroups for Q4_K gate-up + GLU, FA handling for GQA 2/6 with head size 256 — Qualcomm-contributed Adreno path: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31633
  • OpenCL Adreno X2: f32 and Q5_K multi-column GEMV enabled by default for faster MTP verification — PR #31694; non-contiguous sigmoid — PR #31687; Q4_0 non-MoE GEMM bin kernel for Adreno X1 — PR #30947
  • GGUF writer: host-buffer tensors written directly, skipping the staging copy (b12101) — meaningful for large model conversion/write throughput: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31144
  • HIP fast-math enabled without regressions — open PR: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31625
  • Vulkan Intel prefill FA kernel — open PR: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29357
  • MTP conv snapshots batched into a single set_rows for recurrent models (qwen4exp, glm5-*) — PR #31660, follow-up on #30878/#31443/#31584

5. Stability & Regressions (ranked)

  1. CUDA illegal memory access — Gemma 4 31B + draft-MTP after KV rollback/clear on RTX 4060 Ti (#31077); also qwen4exp + draft-MTP abort with GGML_ASSERT(buffer) on server start (#30860). No fix PR linked yet — high severity for MTP users.
  2. Vulkan Intel nondeterminism — KHR_coopmat returns different/wrong results on Arc Pro B70 (BMG G31, Mesa 26.2.5) for BERT-style decision models in F16 and Q8_0 (#31560); shared-memory budget undercount in coopmat_stage on RTX 4090 (#31629). Correctness — treat Intel Vulkan coopmat as unsafe for decision/classifier workloads until fixed.
  3. Vulkan Intel regressions — Arc Pro B60: tg128 20.1→13.0 t/s, pp512 1117→821 t/s between 65840ed and 29c720e (#31557); Gemma 4 decode −5% bisected to 0bb496db (#30018); ANV FA scalar-path fallback causing O(N²) PP degradation (#27638).
  4. SYCL memory — --fit undercounts usage leading to runtime overflow (#27595); prior extreme scratchpad with ngram-mod closed stale (#28860).
  5. Vulkan device loss on AMD RX 6900 XT (#27076, stale).
  6. Server correctness — /v1/responses reports truncated tool calls as completed and never emits function_call_arguments.done (#30773, contract violation); /slots restore yields no KV reuse on hybrid/recurrent/SWA models (#28194); router scheduler race on concurrent cold-start with --models-max 1 (#28774).
  7. Fixed today: realtime crash on invalid tool schema (#31626, closed via b12119); GGUFReader scalar-array OOB loop (PR #31627, closed).
  8. Hexagon — HTP v73 MUL_MAT inf for n≥5 and FA/DeltaNet failures (#29473); vision encoder corruption by image shape on HTP v75 (#31104). Snapdragon 7-series effectively non-functional for now.

6. What This Means for Application Developers

  • Upgrade to v0.9.0 if you serve multi-sequence workloads — flash_attn_ext_rows makes unified KV efficient under parallel decoding, directly improving llama-server --parallel memory/throughput. Validate FP8 E4M3 quant paths against your eval set before rolling out.
  • Tighten -hf quant tags: the new token-boundary matching fixes a real footgun where :F16 silently pulled BF16 weights. Audit any pinned model references.
  • MTP/speculative decoding remains the top risk area: two open CUDA abort/IMA bugs (#31077, #30860) affect Gemma 4 and qwen4exp with --spec-type draft-mtp. If you rely on speculative decoding in production, pin to a known-good build and gate MTP behind a fallback to no-spec.
  • Avoid Intel Vulkan coopmat for classifier/decision models until #31560 is resolved — nondeterministic outputs are worse than slow outputs for agent routing layers. Arc B-series also shows measurable regressions (#31557).
  • Realtime/websocket endpoints got safer: invalid tool schemas now surface as error events rather than crashing the server — update client error handling to consume these events.
  • OpenAI-compat gaps matter for agent frameworks: /v1/responses streaming lacks the terminal function_call_arguments.done event (#30773). If your SDK waits on it, you'll hang — either patch client-side or track the issue.
Ollama — ollama/ollama

Ollama Digest — 2026-11-05

Today's Highlights

No new releases in the last 24h, but the issue tracker shows a cluster of native tool-calling and API-correctness regressions in v0.40.13/0.40.14 (Windows RTX 5090 runner disconnects, Qwen tool-call failures, Responses API truncation). On the PR side, MLX Qwen3/3.5 YaRN scaling landed, VRAM prediction for hybrid models is flagged as over-counting, and several fixes target OpenAI-compatible tool-result handling and SSE flushing.

Releases & Breaking Changes

None. No new version tags in the last 24h. Note: several reports reference v0.40.13 and v0.40.14 as current; cloud /api/usage appears to have regressed (see Stability).

New Model & Hardware Support

  • MLX Qwen3/Qwen3.5 YaRN scaling — PR #19231 (closed) honors explicit RoPE scaling metadata, applies YaRN frequencies/amplitude to text and mRoPE while preserving non-rotary dims. Fixes #18262 (YaRN ignored above 262K) and #19129. https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19231
  • MLX CUDA device rejection — PR #19521 (closed) rejects unsupported CUDA architectures up front instead of failing later with a confusing load error. https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19521
  • AutoTrust decision models on MLX — PR #19399 (closed) adds text/vision AutoTrust routing. https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19399
  • WSL2 RTX Spark N1X GPU memory discovery — PR #19520 (open) patches GPU memory detection for unified-memory laptops under WSL2. https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19520
  • Linux/Windows video input — #19503 (open) requests MP4/MOV support for llama-server GGUF models (currently macOS/MLX only). https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19503
  • Installer size — #12268 and #19512 propose splitting GPU runtime bundles (CUDA 12/13, ROCm, Vulkan, CPU-only) to shrink Linux/Windows installers. https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/12268

Performance & Optimization

  • VRAM prediction over-counts KV cache 4–8x for hybrid/SSM models (Qwen3.5/3.8, Qwen3-Next) and ignores OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE, always billing f16 — issue #19463 (open). Causes premature eviction of keep_alive=-1 runners. https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19463
  • GGUF pull verification — #19504 proposes verifying blobs during parallel Range download to avoid costly post-pull full re-hash ("verifying sha256 digest"). https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19504
  • SSE streaming flush — PR #17027 (open) flushes OpenAI-compatible streaming chunks promptly to fix apparent UI hangs (Chatbox/OpenWebUI). https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/17027
  • Apple Silicon GPU memory docs — PR #19527 documents the unified-memory GPU cap and how to raise it. https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19527
  • Sleep prevention during inference — PR #19525 (open) adds server-side sleep inhibition. https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19525

Stability & Regressions

Ranked by severity:

  1. CUDA v13 grammar-constrained crash → Xid 79 (GPU off bus) — #17026 (open). Long format-constrained generation on cuda_v13 crashes; identical workloads fine on cuda_v12. Highest severity (hardware-level). https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/17026
  2. Windows RTX 5090 runner disconnects during tool calling (HTTP 500 /tokenize) — #19439 (open). Intermittent on 0.40.13 with Open WebUI. https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19439
  3. Qwen2.5-Coder / Qwen3 fail native tool calling on 0.40.13 — #19524 (open). https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19524
  4. Responses API silently truncates oversized input with truncation disabled — #19492 (open), repro on 0.40.13 and 0.40.14. https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19492
  5. Vision inference 500 on GPU — qwen2.5vl:3b fails "token repeat limit reached" on GPU vision encoder; CPU works. #19483 (open). https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19483
  6. Qwen2.5 template renders Go struct dump instead of JSON for {{ .Function }} — #19529 (open); tool names misspelled, calls dropped. https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19529
  7. Cloud /api/usage regression — #19511 (open): session/weekly percentage fields dropped, only request counts returned; likely unintended regression. https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19511
  8. Cloud deepseek-v4-pro rejects max_tokens > 65536 despite ~384k output capability — #19517 (open). https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19517
  9. Long-standing TLS pull failure — #3504 (open, since Apr 2024): pull manifest TLS handshake timeout, still reproducing. https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/3504

Fix PRs in flight: #19522 (keep tool-result text+image in one message, fixes #19479), #18767 (match tool result groups by tool_call_id, fixes #18762), #19526 (legacy templates preserve helpers/define), #19528 (Modelfile FROM quoting round-trip), #19408 (bound MLX System One prompt expansion, 413 on oversize).

What This Means for Application Developers

  • Tool calling is the fragile surface right now. If you depend on native tool calls with Qwen2.5/Qwen3 on Windows/GPU, pin to a known-good version and validate tool-name fidelity server-side; template JSON corruption (#19529) and runner disconnects (#19439) will surface as dropped or malformed calls.
  • Parallel tool results need tool_call_id matching. Until #18767 lands, order-sensitive backends can misattribute results — send tool results in call order or normalize client-side.
  • Responses API truncation is silent (#19492): enforce client-side input length checks rather than relying on server truncation flags.
  • Sizing estimates for hybrid/SSM models are unreliable (#19463): budget VRAM conservatively and don't assume OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE is honored until fixed.
  • Cloud usage telemetry changed shape (#19511, #12532): don't hard-code percentage fields in dashboards; request counts only may be available via API.
  • Streaming clients should tolerate delayed chunk delivery until #17027 merges — long apparent hangs may be buffering, not inference stalls.
LiteLLM — BerriAI/litellm

LiteLLM Digest — 2026-11-05

1. Today's Highlights

LiteLLM pushed three releases in the last 24h (v1.108.0 stable, v1.106.7 patch, v1.109.0-rc.1), all gated on cosign image signature verification. The issue queue remains dominated by streaming correctness and billing-accuracy bugs — early client disconnects, mid-stream fallbacks, and budget-window accounting are all producing silent cost/quota gaps. A large 9-PR "control plane" stack (dataplane registry, OCSF audit events, SIEM sinks, fleet aggregation) is in active review, signaling a push toward multi-dataplane fleet management.

2. Releases & Breaking Changes

Release Notes
v1.108.0 Stable. All Docker images (litellm, litellm-database, litellm-non_root, docker.io/litellm/*) now signed with cosign; verify against key in commit e82a3c6. Release
v1.106.7 Patch on the 1.106 line with the same cosign verification command. Release
v1.109.0-rc.1 Release candidate — same signature story; expect API surface changes to settle here. Release

Model-map regression to watch: eu.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 was removed from model_prices_and_context_window.json and the model map in #49113/23595f7fe, but AWS still serves it as an EU inference profile — deployments pinned to that ID will fail resolution. #49312

3. New Model & Hardware Support

  • QwenCloud migration path requested for the existing DashScope provider (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints for Qwen, Wan, CosyVoice). #36150 — closed.
  • Cloudflare Workers AI image and audio support requests closed as stale/duplicate — not landing. #35055, #35056
  • Rust router core proposed as an alternative to the Python core, with the host as the only boundary (PythonHost bridge, no native executor path). In review. #49513
  • No new CUDA/ROCm/Metal or quantization-format work surfaced today.

4. Performance & Optimization

  • MCP tools/list latency regression: after upgrading v1.106.6 → v1.108.0, tools/list through /mcp/ blocks 18–50s for clients sending notifications/initialized with pre-2026 protocol versions (e.g. Python mcp SDK ClientSession, used by Open WebUI) — traced to the legacy subscription listener. #50065
  • Least-busy routing stampede fix: requests arriving together read identical in-flight counts and pile onto one deployment; PR reserves each pick at selection time so the next request sees it as busy. #47484
  • Health probes evicting context: with concurrency 1 against a 262k-context local model, health checks reportedly cause context eviction and periodic latency spikes as context fills. #49930
  • Prompt-cache misses on tool loops: /v1/messages → Vertex Claude sends messages before system/tools, breaking prompt-cache hits across tool-loop rounds. #50070

5. Stability & Regressions

Critical — billing/usage correctness:

  • Streaming usage loss on early disconnect: if a client aborts before the final usage chunk, all token/cost tracking for that request is dropped — billing gaps and inaccurate quotas. High severity for any metered deployment. #14457 (open)
  • Budget-window spend drops in-flight requests: /key/update during a live request means that request's cost never reaches LiteLLM_BudgetWindowSpend (spend logs and key spend are correct; only the window total is wrong). #49179 — closed.
  • Session budget bypass under concurrency: admission checks recorded spend but don't reserve capacity for in-flight calls, so concurrent requests can exceed max_budget_per_session. #34732 (open)
  • Regional/speed multipliers lost on custom per-call prices since #49532 — OpenAI data-residency, Vertex regional, and Anthropic geo-routing uplifts all dropped. Fix PR: #50063. Related batch-cache pricing fallback: #50062.

High — streaming/fallback correctness:

  • Fallback lost after reasoning-only prefix: sent_first_chunk flips on any delta including reasoning, so a mid-stream failure during thinking is misreported as post-first-chunk and the fallback is skipped even though the client received nothing. #49795 (open)
  • SSE keepalive commits a 200 before upstream failure: with sse_keepalive_ping_interval_seconds, the first : ping commits the response, so later upstream errors can only be written into the body — Anthropic clients on /v1/messages get an SSE error payload instead of a proper failure. #49711 (open)
  • Responses bridge duplicates tool-call arguments in /v1/chat/completions streaming for azure/responses: first delta carries full arguments JSON, then argument deltas re-send fragments. #48773 — closed.
  • Anthropic server_tool_use surfaced as pending tool_call makes agent clients loop (finish_reason stop with both content and tool_calls). #48384 (open)

Medium — translation/provider edge cases:

  • chatgpt/ provider drops encrypted reasoning on /v1/messages → never replayed between tool calls. #49046
  • Azure Messages→Responses detour drops encrypted reasoning on resumed tool-call history (follow-up to #40451). #50024
  • Bedrock Converse replays reasoningText.signature to non-Anthropic models (e.g. zai.glm-5.3) → 400. #49969
  • Groq rejects history after streamed reasoning reply because reasoning_content is echoed back. #47931 — closed.
  • Databricks tool-only responses (no content key) raise KeyError in resolve_reasoning_and_content. #48637
  • text.format: json_schema forwarded verbatim to providers that only support json_object → 400 surfaced as 500. #49198
  • bedrock/openai invoke route ignores model_id (application inference profile ARN) → 400 Unknown parameter. #49083
  • OTel set_attributes calls .get() on non-dict responses (DecisionsResponse, MCP CallToolResult, list) → crash. #48719
  • Sticky sessions not honored — router sends to a different endpoint. #50029

Guardrails:

  • MCP tools sent via Anthropic /v1/messages are invisible to custom_code and tool_permission guardrails in pre_call — they can't be inspected or blocked. #40583 — closed.
  • Streamed multi-choice completions inspect all choices' tool calls together, causing missed masking and false per-choice limit trips. Fix PR: #46860.

6. What This Means for Application Developers

  1. Don't trust usage numbers for aborted streams. If your app cancels streaming requests (timeouts, user navigations, agent step budgets), those tokens may never be billed or counted against quotas. Budget for this gap until #14457 lands, and avoid relying on LiteLLM-side spend as your sole source of truth for usage-based pricing.
  2. Mid-stream reasoning fallbacks are unreliable. With reasoning models, a provider failure while "thinking" will not trigger your configured fallback (#49795), and keepalive-enabled streams can't surface upstream errors cleanly (#49711). If you need resilient reasoning-model serving, prefer non-streaming or implement client-side retry/fallback.
  3. Pin model IDs, verify images. v1.108.0 is stable; the Claude Haiku EU inference-profile removal (#49312) is a live footgun for anyone using regional Bedrock IDs. Verify cosign signatures before rollout — that's now the documented release contract.
  4. Agent-loop UX regressions are real. Anthropic server_tool_use as pending tool_call (#48384) and dropped encrypted reasoning on the chatgpt/ path (#49046, #50024) both cause looping or lost reasoning history for Claude Code-style clients on /v1/messages. If you route agent traffic through the Anthropic-compatible endpoint, test tool loops explicitly.
  5. MCP gateway latency: if you upgraded to v1.108.0 and use MCP with the Python SDK client, expect multi-tens-of-seconds tools/list stalls (#50065) — pin v1.106.6 or wait for a fix if MCP discovery is on your critical path.
  6. Control-plane direction: the 9-PR stack (dataplane registry → fan-out aggregates → audit/OCSF/Splunk/Sentinel/S3-Object-Lock sinks → OTel spans) points to a future where one LiteLLM control plane governs many dataplanes. Worth tracking if you run multi-cluster gateway fleets; nothing to adopt yet. Start at #49655.
Unsloth — unslothai/unsloth

Unsloth Digest — 2026-11-05

1. Today's Highlights

Unsloth shipped v0.1.915-beta, adding Qwen3.8-Flash-Next support alongside Glass theme polish, a Composer position slider, and built-in browser file interaction. On the infrastructure side, the big in-flight work is CUDA-graph decoding enabled by default in plain model.generate() (#16691) plus a wave of multi-GPU diffusion placement PRs from danielhanchen. Stability remains a concern: a cluster of desktop/Studio regressions landed today, most notably UI lag on long conversations (#16603) and a recurring disappearing search_conversation tool (#16602, #16706), with a transformers 5.23 compatibility break flagged for the training stack.

2. Releases & Breaking Changes

  • v0.1.915-beta — Improved Customization + Glass + Browser Use: adds Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, Glass themes (Beta), Composer position slider, lower idle memory, preserved chat context on GGUF model switch, faster MLX loading, FP8 improvements. No documented breaking API changes.
  • ⚠️ transformers 5.23 renamed gradient checkpointing → activation checkpointing (#16667): old names remain as aliases until v6, but Trainer now reads only new names. 4 spots in Unsloth change behaviour — audit before bumping transformers.
  • Install/docs mismatch: advertised brew install --cask unsloth fails — no Cask exists yet (#16672).
  • Torch 2.13/2.14 extras missing from PyPI (#16520, closed) — verify wheel availability before relying on cu130-2130-style extras.

3. New Model & Hardware Support

  • Qwen3.8-Flash-Next — added in v0.1.915-beta.
  • Inception Mercury (diffusion LLM) preset with live diffusion streaming (#16508).
  • Multi-GPU diffusion (FLUX.1/FLUX.2): automatic partner-card selection and second-card copy (#16682, #16687).
  • HunyuanVideo-1.5 small-host planner fixes on 15 GB cards / 31 GB hosts (Kaggle T4) (#16700).
  • Qwen-Image now keeps bf16 text encoder automatically when VRAM allows (#16678).
  • Backends touched: CUDA, MLX (faster loading), FP8, GGUF.

4. Performance & Optimization

  • CUDA-graph decode by default in generate() (#16691): Qwen3-0.6B launches ~675 kernels/step (1070–1430 with LoRA); on T4 GPU busy only a fraction of each 30–75 ms step. Captured decode is bitwise equal to eager, with memory release and eager fallback.
  • RoPE kernel Triton specialization fix (#16690): marks seqlen as non-specialized to avoid duplicate kernel variants between decode (len=1) and prefill.
  • SDXL pipeline load: 24–25 s → faster on L4 by reading v-prediction markers once and skipping the UNet scheme probe (~6 s saved) (#16696).
  • Qwen-Image quality/latency: int8 ConvRot encoder was most of the LPIPS gap to bf16 (0.0865 mean, 0.401 worst prompt); auto-bf16 when resident (#16678).
  • Lower idle memory + faster MLX loading in v0.1.915-beta.
  • tok/s badges for API providers (#16506) and real token usage/context window for custom connections (#16505) — observability improvements.

5. Stability & Regressions

Ranked by severity:

  1. UI lag on long conversations (web + desktop) — open regression, no fix PR yet (#16603).
  2. search_conversation tool disappears (2nd and 3rd occurrences) — recurring; recurrence after closure suggests incomplete fix (#16602, #16706).
  3. Chat template drops arbitrary chat_template_kwargs (only 3 keys pass through; breaks e.g. Sage-A1.5 verification) (#16545, closed).
  4. gemma-4-thinking chat template removes reasoning (#16699).
  5. Studio web_search always "No results found" — missing Accept header (DDG 202) + yandex missing from allow-list (#16664).
  6. S3 audio ingestion correctness: single-record .json manifests skip path rewriting (#16630); prefix-root collisions silently select wrong recording (#16528) — silent training-data corruption.
  7. Fine-tuning jobs API drops cancelled queued job when a newer job starts (#16632).
  8. Mixed ShareGPT + native tool calls lose tool-call metadata (#16051, closed).
  9. AppImage fails on Slackware64-current (GLib/AppIndicator symbol lookup) (#16605).
  10. Native quant test order-dependence fixed (#16704, closed); several desktop update-failure reports (#16573, #16561, closed).

6. What This Means for Application Developers

  • Free default speedup for local serving: the CUDA-graph decode path in plain generate() is bitwise-identical and opt-out via eager fallback — expect material tok/s gains on consumer GPUs (T4-class) without code changes.
  • Pin transformers <5.23 until the checkpointing rename is fully absorbed; the Trainer behaviour change can silently alter training results.
  • Don't trust surface-level chat-template behavior: chat_template_kwargs filtering means provider-specific flags (e.g. verification/agentic modes) are dropped — validate end-to-end if you depend on them.
  • Gateway integrations: custom headers for remote providers are still unsupported (#14811, closed) — plan LiteLLM-style tracking/feature-selection headers accordingly; custom-connection usage/context reporting is improving.
  • Agent tooling: browser script execution is getting an "Always allow" option (#16707) — relevant for unattended agents; sandbox granularity requests (#16625) and persistent project/agent memory (#10775) signal where the agent platform is heading.
  • Training pipelines: audit S3/single-record manifest handling before pushing datasets — the two audio bugs produce incorrect training pairs without errors.

AI 官方内容追踪报告 2026-11-05

今日更新 | 新增内容: 7 篇 | 生成时间: 2026-11-04 23:22 UTC

数据来源:

  • Anthropic: anthropic.com — 新增 1 篇（sitemap 共 493 条）
  • OpenAI: openai.com — 新增 6 篇（sitemap 共 1110 条）

AI 官方内容追踪报告

抓取日期：2026-11-05 | 增量更新

1. 今日要点

本周期最具影响力的内容是 Anthropic 发布了《大型语言模型可证明推理的进展》，推出了 FlashProve——一个用于密码学验证模型响应确实由所声称模型生成的系统，这是迈向可验证模型身份与合规工具化的第一步。OpenAI 方面，新闻周期由企业级信号主导：新任首席企业事务官（Jill Hazelbaker）、宣布收购（Pierre），以及一项显然面向政府的云部署（"Daybreak Red AWS GovCloud"）。OpenAI 还显示出向物理世界工程工具领域扩张的信号，以及一篇聚焦安全的出版物（"A Thousand Fewer Paths to Root"）。总体而言，当日的对比十分鲜明：Anthropic 在发布前沿信任/验证研究，而 OpenAI 在执行企业、商业与收购战略。

⚠️ 数据局限性说明： 全部六条 OpenAI 条目均为仅元数据（标题由 URL slug 推导；未抓取正文内容）。因此，下方 OpenAI 条目仅客观列出链接与分类，不做任何推断性摘要。

2. Anthropic / Claude 内容要点

研究

大型语言模型可证明推理的进展

  • 发布时间： 2026-11-02/03（索引于 2026-11-03）| 分类： 研究 | 链接： https://www.anthropic.com/research/provable-inference
  • Anthropic 前沿红队与学术研究者（EPFL、MIT、StarkWare、Succinct）合作，发布了一份执行摘要与技术报告，推出 FlashProve——一个用于推理密码学证明的系统。核心问题界定：用户目前无法验证响应是来自所声称的模型而非被替换的模型（例如路由服务出于成本原因切换模型，或攻击者篡改 token 流）——而仅凭输出质量判断并不可靠。
  • 所提出的方案允许模型提供方对模型做出承诺，然后证明每个响应均由该模型生成，其可信度建立在形式化验证之上。报告明确将其与更广泛的合规工具包联系起来，包括"验证对 AI pacing 要求的合规性"——这是一个值得注意的、与政策相关的表述。
  • 文档结构（执行摘要 → 引言 → 信任挑战 → FlashProve 系统 → 形式化验证带来的可信度 → 先前工作 → 局限性）表明摘要附有完整技术报告，并公开披露了局限性。
  • 战略解读： 这是一步信任与验证的棋，而非能力之争。它将 Anthropic 定位为构建 AI 部署中可问责性的基础设施——与企业采购、模型路由/API 完整性，以及围绕模型身份与 pacing 的新兴监管制度相关。

本增量周期内 Anthropic 其他分类（新闻 / 工程 / 学习）无新增条目。

3. OpenAI 内容要点

⚠️ 数据局限性： 以下六条均为仅元数据。标题由 URL slug 推导，可能不准确。无文章正文可用，因此不提供任何内容摘要、解读或推测——仅按表面分类与链接客观列出。

公司 / 企业（表面）

标题（来自 slug） 日期 链接
Jill Hazelbaker Chief Corporate Affairs Officer 2026-11-04 https://openai.com/index/jill-hazelbaker-chief-corporate-affairs-officer/
OpenAI to Acquire Pierre 2026-11-04 https://openai.com/index/openai-to-acquire-pierre/

企业 / 政府 / 基础设施（表面）

标题（来自 slug） 日期 链接
Daybreak Red AWS GovCloud 2026-11-04 https://openai.com/index/daybreak-red-aws-govcloud/
Accelerating Engineering for the Physical World 2026-11-04 https://openai.com/index/accelerating-engineering-for-the-physical-world/
Accelerating Engineering for the Physical World （抓取中的重复条目） 2026-11-04 https://openai.com/index/accelerating-engineering-for-the-physical-world/

安全（表面）

标题（来自 slug） 日期 链接
A Thousand Fewer Paths to Root 2026-11-04 https://openai.com/index/a-thousand-fewer-paths-to-root/

数据质量说明：

  • "Accelerating Engineering for the Physical World" 条目在抓取中出现两次（可能是重复或重新发布/更新的条目）；应与源站核实。
  • "Daybreak Red AWS GovCloud" 和 "A Thousand Fewer Paths to Root" 包含的术语（Daybreak、Red、root）仅凭 slug 无法确定其含义——标记为后续抓取跟进，而非解读。
  • 全部六条共享 2026-11-04 时间戳，表明为单日批量发布，这本身即是一个信号（见第 4 节）。

4. 战略信号分析

Anthropic —— 技术优先级

  • 将安全/信任作为研究产品线。 FlashProve 将 Anthropic 前沿红队的产出从模型行为安全扩展到基础设施级信任：推理的密码学证明。这是一个差异化优势，直接对应企业保障、API 完整性与监管合规（"AI pacing"措辞暗示政策参与）。
  • 学术合作模式。 与 EPFL、MIT、StarkWare 和 Succinct 的合著（加上 Anthropic 的 Fellows/STEM Fellows 项目）显示出一种刻意战略：通过学术合作将严谨的验证研究外部化——既增加可信度，又拓宽人才管道。
  • 节奏： 本周期仅一条深度研究条目——符合"少而重"的发布模式，聚焦差异化而非数量。

OpenAI —— 技术优先级（仅从标题/分类推断，非内容）

  • 企业成熟化： 首席企业事务官的任命加上宣布收购，指向组织规模化与无机增长（并购）作为战略杠杆。
  • 企业/政府市场进入： AWS GovCloud 相关 slug 暗示公共部门云分发——一个合规密集型渠道，通常先于或伴随政府合同。
  • 超越软件： "Accelerating Engineering for the Physical World" 暗示向物理/工业工程应用定位（仅标题——未验证）。
  • 安全态势： 同一批次中一篇安全标题条目暗示平台加固方面的并行投入。
  • 节奏： 一天六条，严重偏向公司/企业——是企业新闻爆发而非研究爆发。

竞争动态

  • 议程设置按领域分化。 Anthropic 在可验证推理与信任基础设施上设置议程——该领域鲜有直接竞争对手在此深度发布内容。OpenAI 在企业整合、政府云与商业扩张上设置议程。
  • 差异化逻辑： Anthropic 的验证工作隐含批判现状（模型替换、路由不透明）——这是对多模型路由层与成本驱动替换的微妙竞争性抨击，与 API 市场直接相关。OpenAI 的举措关乎规模与分发，而非验证。
  • 谁在跟进： 在可证明推理方面，Anthropic 似乎以具体系统（FlashProve）领先；更广泛的行业参与者讨论过认证，但少有发布形式化验证支持的系统。在政府云方面，OpenAI 似乎在匹配/扩展既有的企业云打法。

对开发者与企业用户的影响

  • 开发者： 若可证明推理成熟，API 消费者将获得端到端验证模型身份的机制——对受监管工作负载、审计以及防御中间商的静默模型降级相关。预计最终会有 SDK/验证工具方面的影响。
  • 企业： 验证层支持采购与合规要求（模型来源、可审计性）。与此同时，OpenAI 的 GovCloud 与收购信号暗示企业/政府合同选项扩大——买家应关注打包、定价与合规认证。
  • 生态： 验证标准可能迫使路由/聚合服务公开认证，将竞争优势转向能够证明实际服务请求的模型的提供方。

5. 值得注意的细节

  • 出现的新术语： Anthropic 摘要中的"AI pacing requirements"——不常见的措辞，暗示围绕 AI 部署速率/规模的政策框架；值得作为可能的新兴监管概念追踪。
  • "Provable inference" / "FlashProve"——一个命名系统与一条独特的研究主线；本追踪器首次出现。以形式化验证（而非经验评估）作为信任基础是一个值得注意的方法论信号。
  • OpenAI 单日密集批次（6 条，均为 2026-11-04）——企业新闻爆发（人事 + 并购 + 云 + 安全）通常先于或伴随战略里程碑（例如企业推进或财报相关讯息）。
  • 政府云信号： slug 中的"AWS GovCloud"表明通过合规云专区进行公共部门分发——一项值得监测 FedRAMP 类影响的合规/政策进展。
  • 收购信号： "OpenAI to Acquire Pierre"——并购活动；目标身份/领域无法从元数据验证（勿假设）。
  • 安全框架： "A Thousand Fewer Paths to Root"——"paths to root"措辞暗示攻击面缩减/提权加固；未验证，标记待全文检索。
  • 重复抓取条目： "Accelerating Engineering for the Physical World" 出现两次——可能是重新发布/更新；需核实。
  • 时间说明： Anthropic 的研究日期为 2026-11-02/03，而 OpenAI 批次为 2026-11-04——Anthropic 在研究实质上领先本周期；OpenAI 在企业数量上占优。

后续建议

  1. 在得出结论前，检索全部六条 OpenAI 条目的全文（尤其是 "Daybreak Red AWS GovCloud"、"Pierre" 和 "A Thousand Fewer Paths to Root"）。
  2. 获取 Anthropic 完整的 FlashProve 技术报告，了解局限性与性能声明。
  3. 监测"可证明推理"是获得行业标准 traction，还是仍为研究产物。
